header: Custom frequency for Microsoft Sentinel data (Preview)
content:
1. For detections set to run more frequently than once a day, the lookback is four times the
frequency. For example, if the frequency is 20 minutes, the lookback is 80 minutes.
2. For detections set to run once a day or less frequently, the lookback is 30 days. For
example, if set to run every three days, the lookback is 30 days
You can enrich alerts by providing and defining more details, allowing you to:
Create a dynamic alert title and description
Add custom details to display in the alert side panel
Link entities

） Important
When you select a custom frequency, we fetch your data from Microsoft Sentinel. This
means that:
1. You must have data available in Microsoft Sentinel.
2. Defender XDR data won't support scoping, since Microsoft Sentinel doesn't support
scoping.
